decisions.reason: The yogurt-on-fruit-puree line builds directly on the firm's core cultured-dairy expertise, and the eathealthy Award gives an early quality signal the firm can readily interpret and build on.
This flavoured organic cheese is promoted as a flagship on the home page and draws on the firm's cheese know-how, so management is likely to keep developing it rather than drop it.
A semi-hard cheese wheel is a close extension of the existing cheese range and the affiliated farmers' milk supply, so it can be absorbed easily, though there is no specific evidence of success.
The spicy cheese line with several variants fits the cheese competence, but a broad line in a narrow-range firm may be trimmed if individual variants fail to perform.
The mild creamy soft cheese rounds out the new range and relies on related soft-cheese knowledge, which makes its early results interpretable and the product worth keeping.
Washed-rind soft cheese needs more specialised ripening knowledge, and with no reported results it carries more risk, but it is still close enough to existing competence to retain for now.
